# SESSION

> Every page of the SESSION module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Session](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-107/docs/nhcx/v1/api/session): The Session calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Submit the session token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-107/docs/nhcx/v1/api/session/endpoints/session-api-hiecm-gateway-v3-sessions): Mints the ABDM gateway session token that every NHCX call carries, from the client ID and secret you received when you registered on the ABDM sandbox...
